en: Color postcard with a modernist urban view: a tall concrete tower and a long slab building identified as Hotel Muntenia, with terraced flowerbeds and a twin-faced street clock in the foreground. The reverse has Romanian handwriting, two violet 5 lei 'Posta Romana' stamps, and cancellations from Pitești and București. Printed caption reads 'PITEȘTI. Hotel "Muntenia"'.
